title: Fleet rejects unpatched PHP bases before compose mutation
steps: Run the deterministic web image policy tests against this branch.
Verify both resolution stances, explicit overrides, stale mappings and direct image switches refuse unsupported PHP before writing compose.
expect: All six policy tests run and pass.
PHP 8.1 and unpatched Joomla aliases produce no selected image.
Supported PHP branches retain their exact mappings; refused switches leave compose unchanged.

tests: PHP 8.1 is refused for new and existing sites on both PHP platforms
an explicit image override cannot bypass the PHP 8.1 refusal or silently upgrade it
a stale mapping cannot resolve a supported request to a PHP 8.1 image
supported PHP branches still resolve exactly and unsupported 8.1 is absent from the catalogue
a direct PHP image switch refuses 8.1 before writing compose, including --no-start
Joomla aliases still on unpatched PHP 8.2.29 are refused without fallback
